summary.name: SimpleDiagrams
summary.one_liner: A native Mac app for making simple, hand-drawn-style flowcharts and diagrams, with free sketch-style shape libraries and a 7-day free trial.
use_cases: Sketching flowcharts and process diagrams quickly
Drawing cloud architecture sketches with AWS or Google Cloud shapes
Mapping value streams or network layouts
Creating org charts and screen flows
Generating diagrams from text descriptions with an AI agent
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SimpleDiagrams as a native Mac app for sketch-style flowcharts, process diagrams and quick drawings that works offline. It offers free sketch-style shape libraries covering AWS and Google Cloud architecture, value stream mapping, networks, education and other domains. Two free, open-source skills let agents such as Claude Code or Codex generate diagrams from a description, placing shapes from the built-in libraries on a grid and connecting them as an editable document. Agents can also draw custom sketch-style SVG shapes that convert to native shapes with fill and line colors linked to color chips.
notable: Free shape libraries for AWS, Google Cloud, networks and more
Open-source skills let AI agents generate and edit diagrams
One-time purchase with no subscription, works offline
caveats: Mac-only: the page names only the Mac app and Mac App Store
Free 7-day trial; a one-time purchase is required after that
The page does not state the purchase price
